entities.summary: The National Union of Protestant Reformed Evangelical Churches of France, better known as the Evangelical Reformed Churches of France, is a Calvinist denomination in France. It has currently around 10,600 members spread over 68 churches, predominant in the Paris area, the southwest, and the southeast of France. National Union of Independent Reformed Evangelical Churches of France is a Christian denomination in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
